experiments.title: Learning when historical context worsens attack-stage decisions
experiments.finding: Higher movement recall than ordinary gating, with more false alerts and higher weighted error in all five conditions

experiments.title: Selecting stage evidence under availability and deadline constraints
experiments.finding: Lower simulated spend but no robust detection advantage; some better F1 comparisons suppress attack warnings

experiments.title: Measuring time-split sensitivity in attack-stage classification
experiments.finding: Time-mixed training raises macro-F1 by .0632/.0383 on identical anchor rows; diagnostic, not deployment improvement

experiments.title: Transferring a context-selection score policy between recent security datasets
experiments.finding: Cost-sensitive hard decisions match context in all 42 views; no added decision benefit. Secondary T1105 policy transfer, not movement/exfiltration confirmation

experiments.title: Temporal validity and warning retention in APT-stage benchmarking
experiments.finding: DAPT cannot support an all-native-class single chronological cutoff; SCVIC has possible recorded-start support but unqualified physical clocks; DSRL is DAPT-derived synthetic data; S-DAPT has no qualified acquired release. Portable planner reproduces PX-082 exactly.

experiments.title: Calibrating stage-conditioned missed-warning risk
experiments.finding: Stage calibration did not repair the primary exfiltration misses; movement absent from calibration; no deployment guarantee.

experiments.title: Recoverability decomposition and seed-ensemble stability
experiments.finding: Mean ensemble erased warnings; roles-state warning union reached 98.78% exfiltration warning recall with 196 benign false alerts.

experiments.title: Cost-ordered acquisition and warning-aware stopping
experiments.finding: 90% attack-confidence stopping saved 7.09% simulated roles acquisition cost in clean budget 2, preserving warning recalls and false-alert count; slight stage-F1 decrease.

experiments.title: Selective risk control under analyst capacity
experiments.finding: Selective calibration completed; low review budgets leave unresolved attacks; no human detection credit assumed.

experiments.title: Chronological risk degradation and recalibration
experiments.finding: Chronological recalibration with simulated label delays recovers warnings at very high false-alert cost; no deployment guarantee.

experiments.title: Hard constraints for a binary warning model
experiments.finding: Six matched expert-score fits; monotonicity alone did not prevent demotion; explicit union veto retained constituent warnings with more false alerts.

experiments.title: Independent four-class two-evidence replication
experiments.finding: Renewed data qualification complete; no newly qualified independent four-class/two-evidence release. Windows-APT metadata requests remain inaccessible.

experiments.title: Warning-Preserving OR-Gate: Generalization, Seed-Count and Adversity
experiments.finding: Known clean seed-union benefit reproduced; AIT strict per-execution improvement criterion not met. See frozen seed-count and adversity outcomes; no universal benefit claimed.

experiments.title: Heterogeneous Warning Gates and False-Alert Accounting
experiments.finding: Heterogeneous extension completed with a fixed original-model workload denominator and duplicate-member control; PX-092 H3 remains failed.

experiments.title: Exfiltration Episode Coverage and Grouped SOC Workload
experiments.scope: Label-defined episodes and simulated review slots; no confirmed incident or analyst effectiveness claim

experiments.title: Diagnosing Exfiltration Episodes Missed by Every Existing Expert
experiments.finding: 12 singleton episode proxies from one endpoint pair; 11 two-packet flows; no positive training support in shared stratum; no prior source warnings in tested windows. No new model or efficacy claim.

experiments.title: Deterministic TCP22 Policy Overlay
experiments.finding: Original OR plus blanket TCP destination-port 22 rule covers 18/18 episode proxies versus 6/18; adds 510 benign-labeled flows and 460 grouped cases. No production enforcement or independent efficacy claim.

experiments.title: Fixed TCP22 Policy Transfer to AIT Executions
experiments.finding: No exfiltration recovery on Wilson/Harrison: all labeled exfiltration uses UDP53. Wilson adds 30 benign warnings and 15 cases; Harrison unchanged. Previously exposed execution-disjoint transfer, not untouched confirmation.

experiments.title: Visual Host Windows as an Additional Warning-Gate Member
experiments.scope: Bounded exploratory pilot on exposed UNRAVELED data; not independent confirmation
experiments.finding: 24 host-hours, 48 Qwen2.5-VL replies. Strict JSON rejected fenced outputs; syntax-only replay: image/text both flag 0/8 diagnostic exfil windows; image adds 1/14 benign warnings, text 0/14. No gate improvement established.

local_followup.finding: Five-minute numeric host summaries add 11/12 missed exfil-positive hours over original gate with 360 added benign hours; add both remaining hours over full gate with 247 added benign hours. No view meets frozen one-percentage-point alert-increase screen.

experiments.title: Visual Reconstruction of APT Stages and Transitions
experiments.scope: Bounded exploratory pilot on exposed UNRAVELED data; not independent confirmation
experiments.finding: Two image replies fail required schema and cover only one of eight hosts each; two matched text inputs exceed 8192-token cap. Native labels verified but stage/transition accuracy not established.

experiments.title: Verifiable Explanations of Warning Loss
Feature Explanation Stability for Missed Exfiltration
Human Review of Verified Warning Explanations
Explainable Restoration of Suppressed Warnings Under a Case Budget
experiments.finding: 123 replay configurations, 369 episode-gap evaluations. Coverage priority selects exactly the same cases as confidence in all nine source/budget cells. At five supplemental slots per window UNRAVELED gains two episode proxies for 331 extra cases including 13 benign-only; neither AIT execution gains an episode. Novelty unconfirmed; first-on-APT claim contradicted by prior work.

experiments.title: Automated Review of Warning-Loss Explanations
experiments.scope: Deterministic software reviewers; not human or LLM results
experiments.finding: 12 cases, 11 unique score vectors, 216 bot reviews. Verifier accepts 12 valid explanations, rejects 36 deliberate contradictions, abstains on 12 incomplete cases. Calculator already 12/12: no answer-accuracy improvement demonstrated. Zero human or LLM reviews.

inference_rule: These are exposed-data development studies. Freeze source and protocol before fitting; keep all registered outcomes. Do not infer independent-campaign efficacy, novelty, or a guarantee from a good score.

completed_manuscript.title: When Better APT Scores Hide Missed Attack Warnings
completed_manuscript.scope: Existing completed models, 36-pair retrospective reanalysis and independent source qualification; zero new fits
completed_manuscript.generalization_limit: One exposed campaign; four-source qualification is not four-source fitted replication

latest_primary_paper.title: When Better APT Scores Hide Missed Attack Warnings
latest_primary_paper.scope: Readable revision of primary paper with PX-092 through PX-097; preserves original numerical evidence and experimental limitations
